RQ-01.In prod: itself (as: Does the LLM review write edges from the variable names rather than the data, and does the bootstrap step delete undirected edges? (Sachs, pass 4b P1-P3: supported))

RQ-02.In prod: itself (as: With neutral names, does the LLM write at most half as many edges as with real names? (bundle 1 N2: supported))

RQ-03.In prod: itself (as: On four more datasets, do moved names steer the LLM's edges, does refinement lower adjacency F1, and does the bootstrap step drop most undirected edges? (bundle 1 N1, N4, P3: inconclusive))

RQ-04.In prod: itself (as: Does the source of a method's order information explain most of its directed-edge accuracy on public benchmarks?)

RQ-05.In prod: itself (as: Do deployed agents take edge directions from names and column layout rather than from the numbers?)

RQ-06.In prod: itself (as: Can a system that holds order as a typed, sourced partial order stay at or above its own data-only output, be only boundedly harmed by wrong knowledge, and reach the best published number in each information regime?)

RQ-07.In prod: itself (as: Can every claim carry calibrated confidence and a machine-checkable derivation, so that the system can decline to claim?)

RQ-08.In prod: itself (as: Can the graph answer 'what happens if we set X?' with a stated identification status, verified on held-out interventions?)

RQ-09.In prod: itself (as: Can the system pick the experiment that settles the most open directions, better than random on recorded real experiments?)

RQ-10.In prod: itself (as: With real names, does a model's ordering of variables get at least 70% of true edges right and contradict at most 10%?)

RQ-11.In prod: itself (as: With neutral names, does the model supply no order information at all?)

RQ-12.In prod: itself (as: With names moved onto other columns, does the model's ordering follow the labels instead of the data?)

RQ-13.In prod: itself (as: Does regression on the model's ordering reach the best published 0.634 on CausalArena's semantic family with columns shuffled?)

RQ-14.In prod: itself (as: Does the same reach the best published 0.524 on the formula family?)
